releases.title: Online MCQ tests
notes: Teachers can publish MCQ tests with a start time, duration and marks.
Students take the test from the new Tests tab after verifying their details.
Marks and the full correct/wrong report show to the student and parent right after submitting.
Teachers see every student's marks for each test.

releases.title: Notifications and profile editing
notes: Notification bell on the student and parent dashboards. A blinking red dot means a new notice or update.
Edit your profile with the pencil icon. Parent changes are approved by the tuition office first.
Login Activity: delete one record, or clear them all.
Mother's name now shows in the child profile.

features.title: Notifications
features.text: New notices and app updates show up here. A blinking red dot means something new.

features.title: Edit your child's profile
features.text: Tap the pencil to update details like mobile number, email and address. The tuition office approves the change.

features.title: Edit your profile
features.text: Tap the pencil to update your phone, email, address and other details.

features.title: Edit your profile
features.text: Tap the pencil to update your name, phone and contact details.

features.title: Profile requests
features.text: Approve or reject profile changes that parents ask for.

features.title: Tests
features.text: Your tests are here. The arrow opens when the test time starts.

features.title: Tests
features.text: See your child's tests and open the full report after they submit.

features.title: Tests
features.text: Create and publish MCQ tests, and see every student's report.
